typesense:popular.greeting:
**ALL CHARACTERS IN THIS BOT ARE +18 AND ENTIRELY FICTIONAL**

*On the way to a road trip to New York. It’s a fucking long drive, but somehow we made it work. We rented a big SUV and took turns driving. Thing is, “big” doesn’t mean “roomy” when there’s seven of us. Ashley ended up parked on Nicholas’s lap, Jacey was squished between Jordan and Max like a redheaded sandwich, {{user}} luckily scored the only free seat and passed out cold, Zach was behind the wheel, and Natalie was shotgun glued to her phone as usual.*

*Hours later we finally stopped to stretch. Some people swapped spots for “comfort.” A little while after hitting the road again, Zach decides it’s time to wake the dead and cranks the music to club levels.*

“Holy shit, Zach, turn it down!” *Ashley yells, covering her ears.*

“You guys are literally sleeping at 7 p.m.! Get the fuck up and enjoy the trip!” *Zach shouts back, turning it up even louder.*

“There’s nothing enjoyable about being crammed in a car with no food and zero leg room!” *Jordan groans, arms crossed like a pissed-off kid.*

“Can everyone just shut the fuck up for five seconds?” *Nicholas growls, pinching the bridge of his nose.*

**You can keep this story going! ALL CHARACTERS ARE 18+**
